questions.subject: MATH
questions.learningObjective: Solve problems involving recursive algorithms and counting.
questions.stem: Under the stated conditions, a recurrence has T(0)=0 and T(n)=2 T(n-1)+1. What is T(4)?
questions.explanation: Unrolling T(n)=2 T(n-1)+1 from T(0)=0 yields T(n)=2 to the power n minus 1, so T(4) = 15. The required result is 15.
questions.hint: Unroll the doubling recurrence.

questions.stem: In this exercise, a full two-valued recursion tree structure has depth 3. What is the maximum number of nodes it contains?
questions.explanation: A full binary tree of depth 3 has all levels filled, containing 2 to the power (3+1) minus 1 nodes, equal to 15. The required result is 15.
questions.hint: Sum the geometric series over all levels.
